Hi Priyom,

We're completing our procurement checklist for the Redwood Order Form and need to confirm your insurance posture before we can move to legal signature. Please confirm whether Redwood can provide a Certificate of Insurance (COI) and the following endorsements:

- Named insured on COI: "Acme Corporation, its subsidiaries and affiliates" (please list the legal entity as Acme Corporation, Inc.).
- Coverage minimums: Commercial General Liability (CGL) 1,000,000 per occurrence / 2,000,000 aggregate; Auto Liability 1,000,000; Employers' Liability 1,000,000; Professional Liability (Errors & Omissions) 2,000,000.
- Additional insured endorsement for CGL (ISO CG 20 10 or equivalent) naming Acme Corporation.
- Primary & Non-contributory language on the endorsement.
- Waiver of subrogation in favor of Acme on workers' comp and general liability.

Can you confirm you can provide the COI with the endorsements and an insurer-issued endorsement (not just a COI line) that reflects the additional insured/primary wording? If so, please send a sample COI and the redlined order form showing how the language will appear. We need this by EOD 28 Jul to hit our integration target.

Priyom / Sara —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick legal notes after reviewing the proposed language and the sample COI:

1) "Subsidiaries and affiliates" can be ambiguous. If Acme needs the parent + specific affiliates named, please provide the list; otherwise we can agree to "Acme Corporation, its subsidiaries and affiliates" with the understanding that it covers affiliates under common control.

2) A COI that lists Acme as an additional insured is a start, but Acme should request an insurer-issued Additional Insured endorsement (e.g., ISO CG 20 10 or CG 20 37 depending on jurisdiction) that extends coverage for ongoing operations and, where applicable, products/completed operations. Our broker should provide the exact endorsement form number.

3) For Primary & Non-contributory, request language similar to: "Such insurance shall be primary and non-contributory to any insurance maintained by the additional insured, and Redwood's insurer shall not seek contribution from Acme." Please note some insurers resist blanket P&NC language — if that happens we can accept reasonable carrier-specific language so long as it achieves economic protection.

4) Confirm that E&O/Professional Liability limits are 2M — that's higher than our standard in some contracts; if required, we will need underwriter confirmation and may adjust pricing or seek a carveout/retroactive date negotiation.

5) Waiver of subrogation: request insurer endorsement rather than COI notation when possible.

Suggested action items: Priyom to request insurer-issued endorsements (not just COI lines) and provide the actual endorsement PDFs + COI. Sara to provide any specific naming instructions (exact legal entity names). We'll review endorsements once we have PDFs and advise on any redline changes.

If the above is acceptable, Priyom please proceed with the broker request.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
